_readme: Generic MCP server declarations. COPY the variant matching your platform
Keys DIFFER per platform: mcpServers | servers | mcp | context_servers.
Remote URL field varies: url | serverUrl | httpUrl.
CodeGraph is wired automatically by the archgen MCP server (the per-platform
shapes live in packages/mcp/assets/harness-mcp.json) — it needs no entry here.
This file documents the SHAPE for any other MCP server.
Never hand-edit a harness config: use the sanctioned command
(`archgen-skill mcp add --yes`, or the platform's own `mcp add`). It detects
the harness, resolves the absolute binary path, writes the right shape, and is
_antigravity_warning: Remote servers MUST use serverUrl (url/httpUrl are rejected): { mcpServers: { name: { serverUrl: '...' } } }
